title: 第九章 大难将至更新公告
lines: “道祖!这是怎么回事?”玉皇大帝传音道。
此时一向居高临下高高在上的玉皇大帝却惊恐万分，而他的脸上更显露出无尽的恐惧与慌张。
“我怎么知道!你个废物竟然把宝贵的显劫石用坏了”鸿钧怒声喝道。
那玉皇大帝满是冤枉，明明什么都没有做却被鸿钧道祖骂的狗血淋头。
“不过怎么可能出现两个量劫，就算出现，出两个小的量劫也就罢了，可两个如此厉害的量劫竟然同时出现了”
“请问道祖，在下不知两个量劫是何意义”玉皇大帝问道。
“那神魔量劫之前也是听说过的，此量劫如它的名字一样，就是这个洪荒世界的神仙乃至妖魔都会被卷入这场量劫当中，而且非常不可控，搞不好会发生浩劫!不过前几次神魔量劫都是对魔道产生了危害，估计这次也一样吧”
“那三重天雷劫呢，三重天雷劫可有记载”
“那个传说吗?按理来说那只是个传说而已，可是显劫石不可能出错啊”鸿钧喃喃自语道。
“传说那三重天雷劫乃是一个人渡劫天赋的体现，传说只有在一次渡劫中连续经历三九雷劫，六九雷劫，以及九九雷劫的洗礼，而且这九九雷劫必须是那传说中的黑雷劫才有可能触发这三重天雷劫，不过那可是传说啊”
“竟然是有人渡劫触发的这个劫难，此人并非等闲之辈，乃是万中无一的绝世天才啊!”玉皇大帝满脸惊叹道。
与此同时，李磊刚刚渡完劫不一会就醒了。
“这就是人仙的力量吗”李磊兴奋的打量着自己的每一点变化。
成为人仙乃是正式踏入成仙之道的第一步，可紧紧是这第一步却难倒无数英雄好汉。
仙人境界分为:人仙、地仙、天仙、真仙、太乙真仙、大罗真仙、金仙、太乙金仙、大罗金仙。
每一个大境界又分为初期、中期、后期、圆满四个小境界。
大罗金仙之上是洪荒级别的准圣和圣人境界。
准圣分为:一尸准圣、二尸准圣、三尸准圣。
而圣人又分为:亚圣、初阶圣人、中阶圣人、合道圣人。
合道圣人之上就是传说中的天道境和大道境。
天道境分为:境界天道、概念天道、法则天道。
基本上到达了极致，三种天道级别不分先后，全部聚合之后就是下一阶段大道境。
大道境分为:规则大道、因果大道、概念大道，也是不分先后，全部聚合就能超脱一切，跳出本纬度可以掌控的范围，升为高维……
鸿钧道祖苦修多个元会才悟得了法则天道和境界天道。
从这可以看出要想修得大道可真的是比登天还难无数倍啊!
现在李磊正飞升前往九重天。
“小子你有点不简单啊”石头感叹道。
“嘘!小声点，我可不想被人发现身体里有个你这般的存在”李磊满脸慌张的看向四周同是正在飞升成仙的人们。
大千世界巧合很多，就算是遇见长的一模一样的人也不是没有，所以同一时间飞升的也是非常之多。
“哈哈哈，小子你放心，本女王是何等存在，现在你和我属于心灵相通，虽然我不能知道你想的什么，但你和我说话就是玉帝也听不到”
听到那石头的话，李磊也是放下心来。
飞升上天这一路也是非常遥远，那石头也和李磊讲述了他渡劫昏迷发生的事，也和李磊讲述了一些关于境界常识什么的问题，跟是和李磊讲述起了他的血脉和三重天雷劫。
虽然一开始和鸿钧道祖讲的差不多，但后面却和鸿钧讲的有所不同了。
“小子你渡劫可查对你造成伤害的雷的数量?”
“谁没事查那个，光承受雷劫我就已经只撑不住了哪有心查雷的数量，不就是二十七道五十四道以及八十一道吗”李磊回答道。
“错!虽然你没有查雷的数量但是我有查，这就是我判定你触发了那传说中的三重天雷劫的依据”石头笑道。
“什么依据”
“虽然劈入你身体里的雷的的确确是二十七道五十四道和八十一道，但对你造成实际伤害的只是整数的雷也就是说三九雷劫只有二十道对你造成了伤害，六九雷劫五十道，九九雷劫八十道”
“那剩下的雷跑哪去了”李磊问道。
“这就是所谓的三重天雷劫，那几道雷劫不但没有对你造成伤害反而和你融为一体，七道三九雷劫，四道六九雷劫，一道九九雷劫，这十二道雷劫会成为你血脉的一部分”
“这么神奇!”李磊笑了笑。
“呵呵，你还笑!虽然三重天雷劫如果修炼成功能藐视无数天众，但如果不能驾驭好这三重天雷劫，你可是会爆体身亡的，就连你那护体的血脉也都保护不了你!”石头以非常凝重的语气对李磊说道。
content_en:
"Tao Ancestor! What's going on?" the Jade Emperor said in a message.
At this time, the Jade Emperor, who had always been condescending and aloof, was horrified, and his face showed endless fear and panic.
"How do I know! You waste, you actually used up the precious calamity manifesting stone," Hongjun shouted angrily.
The Jade Emperor was full of injustice. He was scolded by Hongjun Daozu even though he did nothing.
"But how could two calamities appear? Even if they did, it would only be two small calamities. But two such powerful calamities actually appeared at the same time."
"Excuse me, Taozu, I don't know what the two calamities mean," the Jade Emperor asked.
"I have heard of the calamity of gods and demons before. This calamity is just like its name. The gods and even demons in this prehistoric world will be involved in this calamity, and it is very uncontrollable. A catastrophe may occur! However, the previous calamities of gods and demons have caused harm to the devil, and it is probably the same this time."
"What about the third level of thunder tribulation? Is there any record of the third level of thunder tribulation?"
"That legend? Logically speaking, it's just a legend, but the calamity stone cannot be wrong," Hongjun murmured to himself.
"Legend has it that the third level of thunder tribulation is the manifestation of a person's talent for overcoming tribulations. Legend has it that only by experiencing the baptism of three nine thunder tribulations, six nine thunder tribulations, and ninety-nine thunder tribulations in one tribulation, and the ninety-nine thunder tribulations must be the legendary black thunder tribulation can it be possible to trigger the three levels of heaven's thunder tribulation, but that is a legend."
"It turned out that someone had transcended the tribulation and triggered this catastrophe. This person is not an ordinary person, but a unique genius!" The Jade Emperor exclaimed in amazement.
…
At the same time, Li Lei woke up shortly after surviving the tribulation.
"Is this the power of immortals?" Li Lei looked at every change in himself excitedly.
Becoming an immortal is the first step on the road to becoming an immortal, but this first step has stumped countless heroes.
The realm of immortals is divided into: human immortals, earth immortals, heavenly immortals, true immortals, Taiyi true immortals, Daluo true immortals, golden immortals, Taiyi golden immortals, and Daluo golden immortals.
Each major realm is divided into four smaller realms: early stage, middle stage, late stage, and perfection.
Above Daluo Jinxian is the prehistoric level of quasi-sage and saint realm.
The quasi-sages are divided into: quasi-sage with one corpse, quasi-sage with two corpses, and quasi-sage with three corpses.
The saints are divided into: sub-sage, primary saint, intermediate saint, and combined saint.
Above the Hedao Saint are the legendary Heavenly Dao Realm and the Great Dao Realm.
The realm of heaven is divided into: realm heaven, concept heaven, and law heaven.
Basically reaching the extreme, the three levels of Heavenly Dao are in no particular order. After all are gathered together, it will be the next stage of Dao Realm.
The realm of the great realm is divided into: the avenue of rules, the avenue of cause and effect, and the avenue of concepts, in no particular order. If they are all gathered together, you can transcend everything, jump out of the controllable range of this latitude, and rise to a higher dimension...
Taoist Hongjun practiced hard for many Yuanhui before he realized the law of heaven and the realm of heaven.
From this we can see that cultivating the Great Way is really countless times more difficult than reaching heaven!
…
Now Li Lei is ascending to the ninth heaven.
"Boy, you are a bit extraordinary," Shitou sighed.
"Shh! Keep your voice down, I don't want anyone to find out that there is a being like you in my body." Li Lei looked around with a panicked look at the people who were also ascending to immortality.
There are many coincidences in the world, even if you meet people who look exactly the same, so many people ascend at the same time.
"Hahaha, don't worry, kid, what kind of existence is this queen? Now you and I have a spiritual connection. Although I can't know what you are thinking, even the Jade Emperor can't hear you talking to me."
Li Lei felt relieved after hearing what the stone said.
The journey to ascend to heaven is also very far away. The stone also told Li Lei what happened when he passed through the tribulation and fell into coma. He also told Li Lei some common sense about realms and other issues. He also told Li Lei about his bloodline and the third level of thunder tribulation.
Although it was similar to what Taoist Hongjun said at the beginning, it was different from what Hongjun said later.
"Boy, can you check the number of thunders that have caused damage to you?"
"Who has nothing to do to check that? I can't even bear the thunder tribulation. I can't bear to check the number of thunders. Isn't it twenty-seven, fifty-four and eighty-one?" Li Lei replied.
"Wrong! Although you didn't check the number of thunder, I did. This is the basis for my judgment that you triggered the legendary triple thunder tribulation," Shitou said with a smile.
"What basis"
"Although the number of thunders that struck your body was indeed twenty-seven, fifty-four, and eighty-one, the actual damage caused to you was only an integer number of thunders. In other words, only twenty of the thirty-ninth thunder tribulation caused damage to you, fifty of the sixty-nine thunder tribulations, and eighty of the ninety-nine thunder tribulations."
"Where did the rest of Lei go?" Li Lei asked.
"This is the so-called three-level thunder tribulation. Not only did those thunder tribulations not cause harm to you, but they merged with you. There are seven thunder tribulations of thirty-nine, four of six-nine thunder, and one of nine-nine. These twelve thunder tribulations will become part of your bloodline."
"So amazing!" Li Lei smiled.
"Haha, you are still laughing! Although if you successfully cultivate the third level of thunder tribulation, you can defy countless heavenly beings, but if you cannot control this third level of thunder tribulation, you will explode and die, and even your body-protecting bloodline will not be able to protect you!" Shitou said to Li Lei in a very solemn tone.
